findings.desc: transition-effects.ts:196-322 — the REVIEW value in buildNextSteps' returned object is an IIFE, so the object literal EAGERLY evaluates it on EVERY buildNextSteps call (transition-orchestrator.ts:509 calls it for every phase transition, then selects nextSteps[phase]). The new surfaceExperienceHints block runs appendActivityLog inside that eager IIFE, so a NON-REVIEW transition (e.g. entering DEV) writes a spurious hidden experience_hint_surfaced event (reviewRound=plan:DEV) even though no REVIEW hint guidance is shown — polluting the A/B measurement. Fix: gate the surfaceExperienceHints firing on story.phase==='REVIEW' so the side-effecting event only fires when the REVIEW guidance is actually delivered. Add a regression smoke: buildNextSteps for a non-REVIEW phase (DEV) with signals+ON arm fires NO experience_hint_surfaced event.
